name: Elm
typeSystem: Static, strong, fully inferred (annotations are optional though encouraged); deliberately excludes type classes and general escape hatches so the type checker can rule out runtime type errors entirely, backed by unusually friendly compiler error messages.
runtime: Compiles to JavaScript; Elm's runtime manages effects and, for browser interfaces, virtual-DOM rendering. Interactive UI applications conventionally use the Elm Architecture (Model-Update-View), while worker programs have no view.

runtimes.name: Compile to JavaScript
runtimes.role: The Elm compiler emits optimised JavaScript that runs in any browser or JS engine.

compilers.name: elm make
compilers.role: The reference compiler; compiles Elm to JavaScript and performs Elm's well-known friendly type checking.

concurrencyModel: Effects and I/O flow through a managed runtime using commands, subscriptions, and message-passing back into a single update loop; there are no user-level threads, callbacks, or shared mutable state.

codeExample.caption: Hello, World! plus a recursive factorial
codeExample.source:
import Html exposing (text)

fact : Int -> Int
fact n =
    if n == 0 then
        1
    else
        n * fact (n - 1)

main =
    text (String.fromInt (fact 10))
